project.name: dandori
project.description: Dandori is a meal-planning co-pilot for a few invited users cooking for themselves: it plans batch-cooked meals, tracks kitchen inventory, adapts to schedule changes and fills an online supermarket cart. Built in Go with templ, htmx, PostgreSQL/pgvector and Claude.

nodes.name: main.go
nodes.summary: Single-binary entry point for Dandori: `serve` reads the environment, picks the Claude, demo or no LLM for Runs, sets up OpenTelemetry, migrates and serves the app with graceful shutdown; `healthcheck` probes /healthz for the container.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses signal.NotifyContext for SIGTERM-driven graceful shutdown and a BaseContext so every request inherits the process context.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Dispatches `serve` or `healthcheck`; for serve it loads the timezone, builds app.Config from the environment, selects the demo or Claude LLM, validates required settings and sets up telemetry with a timed flush.

nodes.name: serve
nodes.summary: Creates the app, starts its scheduler and serves HTTP on addr until the context ends, then shuts the server down gracefully within 5 seconds.

nodes.name: healthcheck
nodes.summary: Calls the local /healthz endpoint and fails unless it answers 200, for the container's health check.

nodes.name: agent.go
nodes.summary: Defines the agent package's LLM port and its wire types: Request, Response, Usage, Message, Block, ToolSpec, effort and stop-reason enums, and RetryableError for failures worth retrying.
nodes.languageNotes: Hexagonal port: the LLM interface keeps the hand-written tool-use loop independent of the Anthropic SDK; Block.Raw lets adapters replay the model's own turn byte-for-byte.

nodes.name: LLM
nodes.summary: Port to the language model: Send takes a Request and returns the model's next turn.

nodes.name: Request
nodes.summary: One call to the model: model, system prompt, messages, tool specs and effort.

nodes.name: Response
nodes.summary: The model's turn: stop reason, content blocks, token usage and refusal reason.

nodes.name: Usage
nodes.summary: Tokens one model turn used, including thinking and prompt-cache reads and writes, serialized to JSON for the Trace.

nodes.name: Message
nodes.summary: One conversation turn: a role and its content blocks.

nodes.name: Block
nodes.summary: One piece of a Message (text, tool use, tool result or other), carrying the raw adapter JSON so the model's turn can be sent back unchanged.

nodes.name: ToolSpec
nodes.summary: Describes a tool to the model by name, description and JSON input schema.

nodes.name: RetryableError
nodes.summary: Marks an LLM failure worth retrying, such as a rate limit or overload, with the wait the server asked for.

nodes.name: anthropic.go
nodes.summary: Claude API adapter implementing agent.LLM over the Beta Messages endpoint, with prompt-cache breakpoints, refusal fallback, effort, span attributes and classification of retryable failures (SDK retries disabled so the loop's retries show in the Trace).

nodes.name: LLM
nodes.summary: Claude client wrapper that implements agent.LLM.

nodes.name: New
nodes.summary: Builds the Claude LLM with SDK retries disabled and a request timeout, credentials coming from the environment.

nodes.name: Send
nodes.summary: Sends a Request through the Beta Messages API with cache breakpoints, fallback and effort, records provider/model/error on the span, and maps the reply back to an agent.Response, keeping only text from a declining model.

nodes.name: toolParam
nodes.summary: Converts an agent.ToolSpec into an SDK tool parameter, parsing its JSON input schema.

nodes.name: messageParam
nodes.summary: Converts an agent.Message into an SDK message parameter block by block.

nodes.name: blockParam
nodes.summary: Converts an agent.Block into an SDK content block, replaying raw JSON when present.

nodes.name: classify
nodes.summary: Wraps rate limits, timeouts, overloaded or failing servers and network errors as RetryableError with the API's Retry-After.

nodes.name: anthropic_test.go

nodes.name: sent
nodes.summary: One request the fake Claude API received: headers, decoded body and raw bytes.

nodes.name: api
nodes.summary: Starts a fake Claude API that answers every request with a fixed status and reply, recording what it was sent, and returns an LLM pointed at it.

nodes.name: TestCacheBreakpointsAndAByteStableSystemPrompt
nodes.summary: Checks that requests carry prompt-cache breakpoints and that the system prompt is sent byte-for-byte identically across calls.

nodes.name: TestFallbackAndEffort
nodes.summary: Checks that the refusal-fallback beta header and the requested effort reach the API.

nodes.name: TestUsageIncludesTheCache
nodes.summary: Checks that the returned Usage includes prompt-cache read and write tokens.

nodes.name: TestTheCallsSpanSaysWhoAnswered
nodes.summary: Checks that the caller's span gains the provider and the model that actually answered.

nodes.name: spanOf
nodes.summary: Runs a call under a recorded span and returns that span's attributes for assertions.

nodes.name: TestARefusalSaysWhy
nodes.summary: Checks that a refusal stop reason comes back with the model's stated reason.

nodes.name: TestAfterAFallbackOnlyTheDecliningModelsTextIsKept
nodes.summary: Checks that after a fallback only the declining model's text is kept, not its thinking or tool calls.

nodes.name: TestFailuresAreClassifiedAndNotRetriedByTheSDK
nodes.summary: Checks that API failures are classified as retryable or not and that the SDK itself never retries.

nodes.name: TestARequestHasATimeLimit
nodes.summary: Checks that a request to the model is cut off by its timeout.

nodes.name: brief.go
nodes.summary: Defines Brief, what the agent is told for one Run (system prompt, first prompt, tools, effort, end check), and Tool, an action the model may call whose errors go back to it as failed results.

nodes.name: Brief
nodes.summary: What the agent is told for one Run: byte-stable system prompt, per-request prompt, tools, effort and an optional Ended check.

nodes.name: Tool
nodes.summary: An action the agent can take, with schema and a Run func whose errors return to the model as failed tool results.

nodes.name: fakellm.go
nodes.summary: Scripted fake LLM for tests: each model request is answered by the next Step (reply, tool calls, failure, overload, hang, delay), recording every request so Runs are deterministic.
nodes.languageNotes: A small step DSL built from value-returning constructors and chainable methods (After, Wait) guarded by a mutex so steps can be scripted mid-Run.

nodes.name: LLM
nodes.summary: Scripted fake model answering requests from its script in order and recording them; safe to extend mid-Run.

nodes.name: Step
nodes.summary: One scripted answer of the model: a turn, a turn derived from the request, an error or a hang, optionally delayed.

nodes.name: Call
nodes.summary: One tool call the fake model makes: tool name and input.

nodes.name: New
nodes.summary: Returns a fake LLM answering with the given steps.

nodes.name: Script
nodes.summary: Appends steps to the end of the fake model's script.

nodes.name: Requests
nodes.summary: Returns a copy of every request the fake model was sent, in order.

nodes.name: Reply
nodes.summary: Step that ends the model's turn with text.

nodes.name: CallTools
nodes.summary: Step in which the model optionally says text and then calls the given tools with JSON-marshalled inputs.

nodes.name: CallTool
nodes.summary: Step in which the model calls one tool.

nodes.name: Respond
nodes.summary: Step answering with a given Response, e.g. to script an unusual stop reason.

nodes.name: Then
nodes.summary: Step computed from the request, as a model reads what its tools returned.

nodes.name: Fail
nodes.summary: Step making the request fail with an error.

nodes.name: Overloaded
nodes.summary: Step failing with a RetryableError, as an overloaded server would.

nodes.name: Hang
nodes.summary: Step that never answers, blocking until the context is cancelled.

nodes.name: After
nodes.summary: Holds a step's answer back until a channel closes, so tests can act while the model is thinking.

nodes.name: Wait
nodes.summary: Delays a step's answer by a duration, as a real model takes time.

nodes.name: Send
nodes.summary: Implements agent.LLM: records the request, pops the next step and answers with it, honouring delays, hangs and cancellation.

nodes.name: loop.go
nodes.summary: The hand-written tool-use loop (ADR-0003): runs a Brief against the model, retries retryable failures with exponential backoff, runs tool calls, bounds turns and emits every step as a Trace Event.

nodes.name: Loop
nodes.summary: Runs Briefs against an LLM with configurable retries, backoff and a turn limit.

nodes.name: Run
nodes.summary: Carries out a Brief turn by turn, emitting each step to the Trace, running tool calls until the model ends its turn, and failing with a *Failure on refusal, token exhaustion, unexpected stop or turn limit.

nodes.name: send
nodes.summary: Asks the model, retrying RetryableErrors with a doubling wait and emitting a Retrying event for each attempt.

nodes.name: runTools
nodes.summary: Runs the model's tool calls in order, reporting unknown tools and tool errors back to the model as failed results instead of failing the Run.

nodes.name: trace.go
nodes.summary: Defines the Trace port and TraceEvent records of a Run (started, asked, said, called, answered, retrying, tokens, failed, ended) plus the Failure error and its Reasons.

nodes.name: TraceEvent
nodes.summary: One Trace Event of a Run: its kind and optional model, turn, tool, text, retry, usage, reason and status data.

nodes.name: Trace
nodes.summary: Port receiving a Run's Trace Events as they happen; Emit must work after cancellation.

nodes.name: Failure
nodes.summary: Error for a Run failing with a Reason and verbatim detail.

nodes.name: TestAStockItemHasItsOwnCount
nodes.summary: A Stock Item's Count is prefilled with its Ingredient and Storage Location, leaving the quantity to state.

nodes.name: TestCountingToNothing

nodes.name: TestEveryCountHappensWhenItIsSaved
nodes.summary: A Count happens at the moment it is saved, which the form has no say in: each Stock Item shows when it was last counted, by the time alone today and with its day before.

nodes.name: TestAStockItemCountedLastYearShowsTheYear
nodes.summary: A Stock Item last counted in another year says so.

nodes.name: TestARefusedCount
nodes.summary: A Count below 0 or finer than its unit is refused on the field, keeping what was typed and leaving the kitchen as it was.

nodes.name: TestACountNeedsAStorageLocation
nodes.summary: A Storage Location that isn't one is refused on the field.

nodes.name: TestStaplesAreNeverOffered
nodes.summary: Staples are never counted: the search doesn't offer them, the Count form doesn't open on one, and a post for one is refused.

nodes.name: TestSearchingForAStapleSaysWhy
nodes.summary: A search for a Staple says why it isn't offered, and doesn't offer to add it again, which would be refused. A search that only resembles one still offers the new name.

nodes.name: TestAConfirmationShowsOnce
nodes.summary: A plain post's confirmation shows on the page it lands on, once: opened again, or reloaded, that page confirms nothing.

nodes.name: TestAConfirmationWaitsPastARedirect
nodes.summary: A plain post's confirmation waits past a page that only redirects, such as the Language choice for a User who has chosen, and shows on the page it leads to. The Count's redirect isn't followed, as when the page it lands on is never reached.

nodes.name: TestACountSearchFindingNothingOffersANewIngredient

nodes.name: TestAnIngredientAddedToCountOpensItsCount

nodes.name: TestAnIngredientAddedToCountSwapsTheCountSheet

nodes.name: TestCountingWithNoIngredients
nodes.summary: With no Ingredient to count, the Count form says how to start.

nodes.name: TestCountingInItalian

nodes.name: TestEachUserHasTheirOwnStock

nodes.name: TestMovementsAreAppendOnly
nodes.summary: The Kitchen Ledger is append-only: the User's role reads and adds Movements and can do nothing else to them.

nodes.name: TestDeletingAUserDeletesTheirKitchen

nodes.name: TestANearMissSuggestsTheIngredientItMeant
nodes.summary: A name close to an Ingredient's, which doesn't normalise to it, suggests that one. The User picks it, adding nothing and finding it in the list, or confirms the name they typed and adds it.

nodes.name: TestTheIngredientsSheetSuggestsInPlace
nodes.summary: The suggestion, picking it and confirming the name typed each answer with the side sheet's body alone when htmx posts them. Picking a name the User has no Ingredient of confirms nothing.

nodes.name: TestANameIsSuggestedForOnLeavingIt
nodes.summary: Leaving the name asks for a suggestion before the form is sent: the one it may have meant, carrying the name's confirmation, or nothing for another food, a blank name, or a name the User has, which adding refuses.

nodes.name: TestSearchingIngredientsBySpelling
nodes.summary: A search ranks the Ingredients by spelling, the most alike first, so a typo still finds the Ingredient; one that finds nothing says so, and a blank one lists them all.

nodes.name: TestEditingAnIngredient
nodes.summary: An Ingredient is edited in place: its name, its nutritional values, fibre and sugar becoming unknown, and its usual Storage Location, at any time.

nodes.name: TestARenameToAnotherIngredientIsRefused
nodes.summary: A rename that normalises to another Ingredient's name is refused on the name, naming that one; renaming to the Ingredient's own name in other words is not. A new name only close to another's suggests it, and saving it again confirms the name typed.

nodes.name: TestTheUnitIsFixedOnceStockIsCounted
nodes.summary: The unit changes while no Movement refers to the Ingredient. Once one does, it is refused on the unit, saying the Movements are recorded in it, even with the Stock Item counted to nothing; the rest of the edit is not saved either.

nodes.name: TestEditingAnIngredientLeavesTheKitchenAsItWas
nodes.summary: Editing nutrition, or renaming, changes no Movement: the Kitchen page holds what it held, under the new name.

nodes.name: TestDeletingAnIngredient
nodes.summary: An Ingredient nothing refers to is deleted. One with a Movement is refused, saying why, and the database refuses it as well.

nodes.name: TestTheIngredientsSheetEditsAndDeletesInPlace
nodes.summary: Posted from the side sheet by htmx, editing and deleting answer with the sheet's body alone, searched as it was: confirmed with the row closed, or refused with the row open as typed and why.

nodes.name: TestDeletingAnIngredientAsksFirst
nodes.summary: Deleting an Ingredient asks once, in the User's Language, naming it, from a step its row's Delete opens; the row has no Delete that posts at once.

nodes.name: TestAnotherUsersIngredientCantBeEditedOrDeleted
nodes.summary: A User can neither edit nor delete another's Ingredient.

nodes.name: TestBrowserEditsAndDeletesInTheSideSheet
nodes.summary: In the side sheet, an Ingredient's row opens to edit it, and saving closes it in place, the sheet staying open; a refused delete keeps it open with why, and a delete, asked once in a sheet over it, takes the Ingredient off the list.

nodes.name: TestTheIngredientsSheetRefusesAndConfirmsEditsInPlace
nodes.summary: Posted by htmx, the edits a plain post makes answer in place too: a value required, a rename to another Ingredient refused and one close to another suggested, then confirmed; the unit changed while nothing refers to the Ingredient; fibre and sugar made unknown; and the Kitchen page holding what it held.

nodes.name: kitchen_test.go
nodes.summary: Seam-1 tests for the Kitchen page's empty state and the scheduler beat that brings every User's kitchen up to now idempotently, even when one User fails.

nodes.name: TestANewKitchenPageSaysHowToStart
nodes.summary: The Kitchen page tells a new kitchen how to start, and opens the Ingredients from the page's header.

nodes.name: TestTheSchedulerBringsEveryUsersKitchenUpToNow
nodes.summary: The scheduler beats every five minutes on the clock and brings every User's kitchen up to now, whether or not they have a page open: each one's Today shows the last beat, which a page opened in between leaves as it was.

nodes.name: TestABeatFailingForOneUserStillBringsTheOthersUpToNow
nodes.summary: A beat that fails for one User still brings the others up to now, and the failure is logged. The User it failed for sees the last beat that didn't, with its day.

nodes.name: TestTheStepRunAgainForTheSameMomentChangesNothing
nodes.summary: Running the step again for the moment a beat brought the kitchen to changes nothing: a page opened then, which runs it first, writes nothing to the kitchen and shows the beat as it was.

nodes.name: language_test.go
nodes.summary: Seam-1 tests for the User's Language: chosen at first sign-in, changed on the Profile, refused values, locked once data or a parse Run exists, and the page lang kept in step.

nodes.name: TestTheFirstSignInAsksForTheLanguage
nodes.summary: A User's first sign-in asks for their Language before anything else. Picking Italian makes the pages Italian, and the next sign-in doesn't ask again.

nodes.name: TestTheLanguageCanBeChangedOnTheProfile
nodes.summary: The Language can be changed on the Profile, while the User has written no Food Term, confirmed in the Language chosen.

nodes.name: TestEachUserHasTheirOwnLanguage
nodes.summary: Each User has their own Language.

nodes.name: TestPagesBeforeSignInSwitchToItalian
nodes.summary: Pages before signing in are in English, with a switch to Italian that the following pages remember, up to the Language choice.

nodes.name: TestTheLanguageChoiceRefusesAnotherLanguage
nodes.summary: A Language Dandori doesn't speak is refused, with the choice asked again.

nodes.name: TestTheProfileRefusesAnotherLanguageKeepingTheUsers
nodes.summary: A change the Profile refuses comes back with the Language as it was.

nodes.name: TestTheLanguageIsChosenOnce
nodes.summary: The Language is chosen once at the first sign-in: the choice, posted again, goes to Today and changes nothing; changing it is the Profile's.

nodes.name: TestTheLanguageStaysOnceTheUserHasAnIngredient
nodes.summary: Once the User has added an Ingredient, their Language stays: the Profile refuses a change, keeping the one they have.

nodes.name: TestTheLanguageCantChangeWhileAParseRunIsGoing
nodes.summary: The Language can't change while a parse Run is going, so its Recipe Draft can't arrive in the one just left; once the Run ends with no Food Term written, it can again.

nodes.name: TestTheLanguageSwitchStaysOnThisSite
nodes.summary: The Language switch opens a page of this site again, whatever slashes its path begins with: a browser reads a location beginning with // as another site's.

nodes.name: TestBrowserKeepsThePageLangInStepWithTheLanguage
nodes.summary: A boosted change of Language leaves the page's lang the new Language's, which a screen reader reads it by, and the page stays closed to a browser's own translation.

nodes.name: look_test.go
nodes.summary: Seam-1 and browser tests for the visual design: pages number their groups, titles set data in the body face, and the sky header is slim except on Today.

nodes.name: TestAPageNumbersItsOwnGroups
nodes.summary: A page numbers its own groups: the Recipe Library, a Recipe, a Run and the Ingredients page. The square is for a side sheet's, such as the Ingredients sheet's.

nodes.name: TestATitleSetsItsDataInTheBodyFace
nodes.summary: A title sets its times, quantities and User text in the body face, where l, I and 1 are told apart: Today's time of day, a Recipe's name.

nodes.name: TestBrowserTheSkyIsSlimOnEveryPageButToday
nodes.summary: On a phone the full sky is Today's: every other page has a slim strip of it, so its first content, after the page's header, sits within 300px of the top.

nodes.name: measure
nodes.summary: measure is the number script works out on b's page.

nodes.name: meal_out_test.go
nodes.summary: Seam-1 tests for the Profile's Meal Out estimate: defaults, saving with optional fibre and sugar, per-field refusals, htmx self-swap and per-user isolation.

nodes.name: TestANewUserHasTheDefaultMealOutEstimate
nodes.summary: A new User's Profile shows the default Meal Out estimate.

nodes.name: TestTheMealOutEstimateIsSavedWithFibreAndSugarGivenOrUnknown
nodes.summary: A saved Meal Out estimate is shown back, and fibre and sugar left blank stay unknown, never 0.

nodes.name: TestARefusedMealOutValueIsRefusedOnItsField
nodes.summary: A required value missing or negative, or a value not whole, is refused on its field, saving nothing, with what was typed kept.

nodes.name: TestTheMealOutSectionAnswersHTMXWithItself
nodes.summary: Posted by htmx, the Meal Out section answers with itself: saved with a Notice, or refused as typed.

nodes.name: TestEachUserHasTheirOwnMealOutEstimate
nodes.summary: Each User sees only their own Meal Out estimate.

nodes.name: move_test.go
nodes.summary: Seam-1 and browser tests for moving stock between storage locations: partial and full moves, refusals, stale forms, Italian, htmx and ordering behind waiting Movements.

nodes.name: TestMovingStockBetweenStorageLocations
nodes.summary: Moving part of a Stock Item leaves the rest and adds to the other Storage Location's, the Stock Item it makes there if none was. Moving all of it removes the source, whose Movements stay.

nodes.name: TestAMoveStartsFromAllOfTheStockItem
nodes.summary: The form starts from all of the Stock Item, in its unit, and leaves the target to the User, offering the two other Storage Locations with what Dandori believes they hold.

nodes.name: TestMovingPartOfAPiece
nodes.summary: A quantity follows its unit's rules: pieces have one decimal place.

nodes.name: TestARefusedMove
nodes.summary: A move is refused on the field, keeping what was typed and leaving the kitchen as it was.

nodes.name: TestCountingFirstLetsAMoveThrough
nodes.summary: When Dandori holds too little, the User counts first and the same move then goes through.

nodes.name: TestAMoveNeedsAnotherStorageLocation
nodes.summary: A move needs a target, which is another Storage Location.

nodes.name: TestAMoveFromAnOldFormIsChecked
nodes.summary: A move is checked against the Kitchen Ledger as it stands, not as the form showed it.

nodes.name: TestAMoveIsNotACount
nodes.summary: The Kitchen page says when a Stock Item was counted, which a move doesn't change: stock only moved somewhere was never counted there, and says nothing.

nodes.name: TestACountStartsFromWhatAMoveLeft
nodes.summary: A Count of stock moved in starts from what the move left there.

nodes.name: TestMoveOfNoStockItem
nodes.summary: A Stock Item holding nothing can't be moved, and neither can another User's. A post for a Storage Location that isn't one is no move at all.

nodes.name: TestMovesInItalian
nodes.summary: A move's cause speaks the User's Language, each Storage Location with its own preposition.

nodes.name: TestAMovePostedAsHTMX
nodes.summary: As htmx posts it, the form answers with a fragment: the move confirmed in a floating Notice alone, closing the sheet and telling the page to list its stock again, or the form itself as typed with why it was refused, confirming nothing.

nodes.name: TestBrowserMovesStockInPlace
nodes.summary: A move from a row happens in its sheet: once saved the sheet closes, the list shows both Stock Items, and a floating Notice says what moved. A refused one keeps the sheet open on the field, confirming nothing.

nodes.name: TestAMoveHappensAfterTheMovementItWaitedBehind
nodes.summary: A move that waited behind a later Movement happens after it, so its Stock Items' Movements end on what the Kitchen page shows.

nodes.name: movements_test.go
nodes.summary: Seam-1 and browser tests for a stock item's Movements ledger: explaining holdings, corrections, per-location links, Italian, fragments and phone layout.

nodes.name: TestAStockItemsMovementsTellWhyItHoldsWhatItDoes
nodes.summary: A Stock Item's Movements answer why it holds what it does: newest first, each with when it happened, its cause, what Dandori believed before and after, and the User's note.

nodes.name: TestAMistakeIsCorrectedByAnotherCount
nodes.summary: A mistaken Count is corrected by another Count, and both stay: the Movements offer no way to change or remove one. A Count that changes nothing is one of them too.

nodes.name: TestEachStockItemHasItsOwnMovements
nodes.summary: A Stock Item is one Ingredient in one Storage Location: its Movements are its own.

nodes.name: TestAStockItemAtNothingKeepsItsMovements
nodes.summary: A Stock Item counted to nothing leaves the Kitchen page but keeps its Movements, which its Ingredient's Count form reaches, in whichever Storage Location it was.

nodes.name: TestACountFormHasOneMovementsLink
nodes.summary: The Count form has one Movements link and one Choose another, whatever Movements its Ingredient has. Without htmx the link opens the Storage Location the form started on.

nodes.name: TestAStorageLocationWithNoMovementsSaysSo
nodes.summary: A Storage Location with no Movements of an Ingredient the User has says so, as a page and in the sheet. A Staple is such an Ingredient, though no Stock Item holds it.

nodes.name: TestMovementsLinkEveryStorageLocation
nodes.summary: The Movements link all three Storage Locations, the current one marked, so without htmx each stays reachable and a move can be followed from one side to the other.

nodes.name: TestMovementsOfNoStockItem
nodes.summary: Only an Ingredient the User has, in a Storage Location, is there to open.

nodes.name: TestAMovementOfAnotherYearShowsItsYear
nodes.summary: A Movement of another year says so; one of this year has no need to.

nodes.name: TestMovementsInItalian
nodes.summary: The Movements speak the User's Language, whatever the Language of their note.

nodes.name: TestStorageLocationsInItalian
nodes.summary: A Count's confirmation says "in" or "nel" as each Storage Location takes it.

nodes.name: TestTheMovementsSheetIsAFragment
nodes.summary: As htmx asks for them, the Movements are the sheet's body alone.

nodes.name: TestBrowserOpensAStockItemsMovementsInPlace
nodes.summary: Opening a Stock Item shows its Movements in the side sheet, newest first, leaving the User where they are on the Kitchen page; a Count form opens them over its sheet.

nodes.name: TestBrowserCountFormHoldsItsLayoutOnAPhoneInItalian
nodes.summary: On a phone, in Italian, the Count form keeps Choose another beside the Ingredient's name, and Movements across from the Count button, without overflowing the sheet.

nodes.name: notice_test.go
nodes.summary: Browser tests for the floating Notice: shown without JavaScript, positioned with the phone keyboard up, and keeping its time as a sheet closes.

nodes.name: TestBrowserANoticeShowsWithoutJS
nodes.summary: With no script, a plain post still lands on a page whose floating Notice shows: the Profile saved, and a Count from its own page.

nodes.name: TestBrowserANoticeOnAPhoneWithTheKeyboardUp
nodes.summary: On a phone with the keyboard up, a Count's floating Notice shows whole at the top of the screen, over the Count sheet, its Close a full touch target that, focused, has the ring a navy ground needs.

nodes.name: TestBrowserANoticeKeepsItsTimeAsTheSheetCloses
nodes.summary: A floating Notice keeps its time as the sheet it shows over closes, from a tap outside it: it doesn't start again.

nodes.name: parse_test.go
nodes.summary: Seam-1 tests for parsing a pasted recipe through an agent Run with the fake LLM: drafts, refusals, retries, turn limits, tool feedback, language handling, prompt stability, concurrency, isolation and the demo LLM.

nodes.name: submittedLasagne
nodes.summary: submittedLasagne is what the model submits for pastedLasagne: rice is known, the rest is new.

nodes.name: TestAPastedRecipeBecomesARecipeDraftThroughARun
nodes.summary: A pasted recipe is read by a parse Run, whose page shows its Trace, into a Recipe Draft showing what the model submitted: the known rice in its own unit, and each new Ingredient's proposed values, fibre and sugar unknown where the model couldn't tell.

nodes.name: TestARefusedPasteFailsItsRunSayingWhy
nodes.summary: A refusal that stands after the fallback fails the Run, saying why the model refused.

nodes.name: TestAPasteThatIsNotARecipeFailsItsRunWithTheModelsReason
nodes.summary: A model that ends its turn without submitting a Recipe fails the Run, its last message as the reason, and no Recipe Draft is offered.

nodes.name: TestTryAgainOnAFailedParseRunStartsANewOneWithTheSameText
nodes.summary: "Try again" on a failed parse Run starts a new one with the same text, without pasting it again; a Run that succeeded doesn't offer it.

nodes.name: TestAPasteOver20000CharactersIsRefusedOnItsField
nodes.summary: A paste over 20,000 characters, counted after trimming, is refused on its field with the limit stated, keeping the text, and starts no Run; one of exactly 20,000 is read.

nodes.name: TestAModelFailureWorthRetryingShowsInTheTraceAndTheRunSucceeds
nodes.summary: A model failure worth retrying is retried, the retry shown in the Trace, and the Run still succeeds.

nodes.name: TestARunPastTheTurnLimitFailsSayingSo
nodes.summary: A model that keeps calling tools fails its Run once it reaches the turn limit.

nodes.name: TestSubmitRecipesProblemsGoBackToTheModelWhichFixesThem
nodes.summary: What submit_recipe can't take goes back to the model, said so it can fix it: here the known rice in millilitres, and a new Ingredient without its values. The model fixes both, and the Recipe Draft is what it submitted second.

nodes.name: TestUnknownKindsGoBackToTheModelAllAtOnce
nodes.summary: Every kind of appliance and of Slot not on its list goes back to the model in one refusal, so it fixes them all in one call and the Recipe Draft holds only kinds.

nodes.name: italianLasagne
nodes.summary: italianLasagne is what the model submits for pastedLasagne in Italian.

nodes.name: TestARecipeInAnotherLanguageBecomesARecipeDraftInTheUsersLanguage
nodes.summary: The parse Run's system prompt names the User's Language, so a recipe pasted in English by a User speaking Italian becomes a Recipe Draft in Italian.

nodes.name: TestTheParseSystemPromptVariesOnlyByLanguage
nodes.summary: The system prompt is the same for every User and paste of one Language, so it is cached; what varies, the User's known Ingredients and the pasted text, comes after it.

nodes.name: TestSubmitRecipesSchemaStatesTheRulesItChecks
nodes.summary: submit_recipe's schema tells the model the rules its checks hold a Recipe to, so a typical one is taken the first time rather than refused: the kinds of appliance, a quantity whole but for a piece's, and nutritional values to one decimal place, none negative or too large.

nodes.name: TestATracesFixedLinesAreInTheUsersLanguageAndTheModelsTextVerbatim
nodes.summary: A Trace's fixed lines are plain words in the User's Language, whichever it is when they look, timed to the minute, each folding its data, the model's and the tool's names included; what the model said is as it said it.

nodes.name: TestSeveralParseRunsGoAtOnceEachMakingItsOwnRecipeDraft
nodes.summary: Several parse Runs can go at once, each making its own Recipe Draft: both are asking the model before either is answered.

nodes.name: TestTwoUsersNeverSeeEachOthersRunsOrRecipeDrafts
nodes.summary: A User sees neither another's Runs, their streams nor their Recipe Drafts, and can't cancel their Runs.

nodes.name: TestARecipeDraftShowsOnlyOnceItsRunHasEnded
nodes.summary: A Recipe Draft shows only once its parse Run has ended, since the model may still change it.

nodes.name: pastesInTheSheet
nodes.summary: pastesInTheSheet pastes text in the sheet the Recipe Library's + opens, focused on its field, and reads it.

nodes.name: TestBrowserAPasteRefusedInTheSheetStaysInIt
nodes.summary: A paste refused in the sheet stays in it, saying why with its field focused, over the Recipe Library.

nodes.name: TestBrowserARunsInputAndTraceDataAreFoldedUntilOpened
nodes.summary: A Run's page folds what the User gave it, the paste, at its top, and its Trace reads as a list of timestamped lines: what the model was sent and what it and its tools said is folded under each, closed until the User opens it.

nodes.name: demoKitchen
nodes.summary: demoKitchen signs a new User in, speaking the Language named language, on an app whose Runs ask the demo model mise run dev uses.

nodes.name: TestTheDemoLLMReadsAnyPasteIntoARecipeDraft
nodes.summary: The demo model makes a Recipe Draft of any paste without a real model: named after its first line, and taking an Ingredient the User knows in the unit they know it in.

nodes.name: TestTheDemoLLMWritesInTheUsersLanguage
nodes.summary: The demo model writes in the Language the system prompt names.

nodes.name: portions_test.go
nodes.summary: Seam-1 and browser tests for Portions and Lots: adding, refusals, grouping alike portions into Lots, counting up and down, moving, Lot Movements, Italian and htmx fragments.

nodes.name: TestAddedPortionsShowGroupedAboveTheStockItems
nodes.summary: Portions no Prep Session produced are added from the Kitchen page and show as one Lot under their Storage Location, above its Stock Items.

nodes.name: TestAddingPortionsRefusesAMissingValueOnItsField
nodes.summary: Calories, protein, carbs and fat are required, each refused on its field with what was typed kept. Nothing is added.

nodes.name: TestAddingPortionsRefusesNoNameAndNoStorageLocation
nodes.summary: A name and a Storage Location are refused on their fields too, and the page, longer than a screen, opens with a summary linking to each.

nodes.name: TestAddedPortionsShowUnknownFibreAndSugarAsUnknown
nodes.summary: Fibre and sugar may be unknown, and show as unknown: never 0.

nodes.name: TestAddingPortionsTakesAWholeNumberOfAtLeastOne
nodes.summary: How many is a whole number from 1 to 99.

nodes.name: TestPortionsShareALotOnlyWhenAlike
nodes.summary: Alike means the same name, ignoring case and surrounding space, the same values and the same Storage Location: anything else is another Lot.

nodes.name: TestAnAddedPortionFixesTheLanguage
nodes.summary: An added Portion's name is a Food Term, so it fixes the User's Language.

nodes.name: TestAddingPortionsSpeaksItalian
nodes.summary: Portions are told in the User's Language.

nodes.name: TestUsersSeeOnlyTheirOwnPortions
nodes.summary: Two Users never see each other's Portions.

nodes.name: TestAddingPortionsAnswersHTMXWithAFragment
nodes.summary: Posted from the sheet by htmx, an add answers with a fragment: the form as typed when refused, and when added a Notice that closes the sheet and lists the kitchen again.

nodes.name: TestBrowserAddsPortionsInTheSheet
nodes.summary: The chevron only chooses what the + adds, and the + opens that sheet. A refused add comes back in it with focus on the refused field; one accepted closes it, shows the Lot and leaves the choice, which a new page forgets.

nodes.name: TestCountingPortionsUpAddsMoreAlike
nodes.summary: A Count up adds Portions alike, which show with the Lot.

nodes.name: TestCountingPortionsDownRemovesThem
nodes.summary: A Count down removes Portions, and a Count to nothing removes the Lot from the page.

nodes.name: TestCountingPortionsRefusesWhatIsNotACount
nodes.summary: A Count below 0, not a whole number, or above what one Count takes is refused on its field, with what was typed kept and nothing changed.

nodes.name: TestMovingPortions
nodes.summary: Moving some leaves two Lots, and moving all the rest joins it to them, leaving one.

nodes.name: TestMovingPortionsRefusesWhatTheLotCannotGive
nodes.summary: A move above what the Lot holds is refused on its field, and so is a move of none, part of one, or to nowhere.

nodes.name: TestALotsMovementsTellWhyItHoldsWhatItDoes
nodes.summary: A Lot's Movements show newest first, with cause, before and after, and the note; one act is one Movement, and a move tells where it went on the side it left.

nodes.name: TestAPortionCountThatChangesNothingIsAMovement
nodes.summary: A Count that changes nothing is one Movement like any other, and is the Lot's.

nodes.name: TestALotsMovementsBeginWithWhatItHoldsNow
nodes.summary: A Lot emptied and filled again starts its Movements over.

nodes.name: TestALotsMovementsInItalian
nodes.summary: Checks that a Lot's Movements page reads in Italian for an Italian-speaking User.

nodes.name: TestNoLotIsNotFound
nodes.summary: A Portion that isn't the User's, or a place that is no Storage Location, is no Lot.

nodes.name: TestPortionFormsAnswerHTMXWithFragments
nodes.summary: A Count and a move of Portions, posted by htmx, answer with no page: refused, the form as a fragment with what was typed; saved, a Notice for the sheet to close under.

nodes.name: TestBrowserOpensALotsMovementsInPlace
nodes.summary: A Lot's Movements open in the side sheet, leaving the User on the Kitchen page, which a plain URL stands in for without htmx.

nodes.name: TestAddingPortionsRefusesMoreThanALotHolds
nodes.summary: A Portion Lot never holds more than 99: an add that would take it past that is refused on its field, and nothing is added.

nodes.name: TestMovingPortionsRefusesMoreThanALotHolds
nodes.summary: A move that would take the Portion Lot it joins past 99 is refused on its field.

nodes.name: TestAStaleCountToNothingConfirmsNothing
nodes.summary: Posting a Count of nothing from a form another write has overtaken finds nothing to record, so confirms nothing.

nodes.name: TestOnlyASheetOrTheCountSearchFocusesAFieldAsItOpens
nodes.summary: The Add Portions page opens with no field focused, so a phone's keyboard doesn't cover it; each sheet, as it opens, focuses its first field, as the Count page its search.

nodes.name: TestBrowserTheAddPortionsPageRefusedOpensOnItsErrorSummary
nodes.summary: With htmx, the Add Portions page refused opens on its error summary, as without, and stays at its address.

nodes.name: profile_test.go
nodes.summary: Seam-1 test that each Profile section's Save button names its section.

nodes.name: TestEachProfileSectionsButtonNamesIt
nodes.summary: Each Profile section saves on its own. Its button shows only Save, and its accessible name says what it saves, in the User's Language.

nodes.name: recipes_test.go
nodes.summary: Seam-1 and browser tests for the Recipe Library: hand-written recipes, new Ingredients in rows, refusals, duplicate names, editing, deleting, typo-tolerant search, row add/remove with and without htmx, and phone layout.

nodes.name: TestARecipeWrittenByHandAppearsInTheRecipeLibrary
nodes.summary: A Recipe written by hand appears in the Recipe Library, and its page shows all of it. 200 g of rice over two Portions is 350 kcal each, and nothing knows its fibre or sugar.

nodes.name: TestTheNavigationReachesTheRecipeLibrary
nodes.summary: The app's navigation reaches the Recipe Library.

nodes.name: TestANewIngredientIsConfirmedInTheFormAndCreatedWithTheRecipe
nodes.summary: A name no Ingredient has opens its row to confirm, saving nothing; confirmed, the Ingredient is created with the Recipe.

nodes.name: TestANewIngredientsMissingValuesAreRefusedOnTheirFields
nodes.summary: A new Ingredient's fields are refused on theirs.

nodes.name: TestARecipeThatFailsCreatesNoIngredient
nodes.summary: A failing Recipe creates neither it nor its new Ingredient.

nodes.name: TestARecipesProblemsAreRefusedOnTheirFields
nodes.summary: Each validation is refused on its field, with the reason, keeping what was typed.

nodes.name: TestASecondRecipeOfTheSameNameIsRefusedWithALinkToTheFirst
nodes.summary: A second Recipe of the same name, ignoring case and surrounding space, is refused with a link to the existing one.

nodes.name: TestARecipesPageShowsFibreAsAFloorWhenAnIngredientDoesntKnowIt
nodes.summary: Fibre an Ingredient doesn't know makes the page say "at least".

nodes.name: TestARecipeFixesTheLanguage
nodes.summary: A Recipe fixes the User's Language, like any Food Term.

nodes.name: TestARecipesKindsOfApplianceAreShownInTheUsersLanguage
nodes.summary: A Recipe's kinds of appliance are shown in the User's Language, on its page and on its edit form, ticked.

nodes.name: TestAnIngredientInARecipeRefusesDeletionAndAChangeOfUnit
nodes.summary: An Ingredient a Recipe lists refuses deletion and a change of unit, naming the Recipe.

nodes.name: TestAnIngredientInSeveralRecipesCountsTheOthers
nodes.summary: More than one Recipe listing it are counted after the first by name.

nodes.name: TestTwoUsersNeverSeeEachOthersRecipes
nodes.summary: Two Users never see each other's Recipes, even by address.

nodes.name: TestARowsNameShowsTheKnownUnitOrTheNewIngredientsFields
nodes.summary: The row's name says what it is as the User leaves it: htmx asks for the known unit or the fields to confirm a new one.

nodes.name: TestBrowserARowFollowsItsNewIngredientsUnit
nodes.summary: In a browser, a row follows its name and a new Ingredient's unit in place: the field the User moved to keeps the focus, the quantity is given in the unit chosen, and the row says what the values are per.

nodes.name: TestABlankRowIsNumberedAfterTheFormsRows
nodes.summary: htmx asks the server for one more row, numbered after those the form has.

nodes.name: TestAddingARowWithoutHTMXKeepsWhatWasTyped
nodes.summary: Without htmx, the add buttons post the form back with one more row, saving nothing and refusing nothing.

nodes.name: removesRow
nodes.summary: removesRow posts form with its row at index pressed Remove, as htmx and as a plain post, checking each comes back as want, saving nothing and refusing nothing.

nodes.name: TestRemovingARowKeepsTheRestAsTyped
nodes.summary: A row's Remove posts the Recipe form back without that row, the rest as typed and numbered on from 0, saving nothing.

nodes.name: TestRemovingARecipeDraftsRowKeepsTheRestAsTyped
nodes.summary: A Recipe Draft's row is removed as a Recipe form's is, a new Ingredient's values moving up with its row.

nodes.name: TestBrowserAddsAnIngredientRowAndConfirmsANewOne
nodes.summary: In a browser, adding a row gives one more, numbered, whose name asks what it is.

nodes.name: TestBrowserEachAddGivesANumberedRowAndFocusesIt
nodes.summary: In a browser, each add gives one more row, numbered after the last, with focus in it.

nodes.name: TestBrowserRemovesARow
nodes.summary: In a browser, a row's Remove takes it off the form, the next row moving up as typed, and the address stays the form's.

nodes.name: TestBrowserTheFloatingPlusOpensTheRecipeForm
nodes.summary: In a browser, the Library's floating + pastes a recipe first, and, Write chosen, opens the Recipe form.

nodes.name: TestBrowserAnEmptyRecipeShowsTheAppsErrorsInTheUsersLanguage
nodes.summary: In a browser, an empty Recipe form is refused by the app, not the browser: its errors are in the User's Language, Italian on an English browser, each refused field marked.

nodes.name: TestTheRecipeFormSaysWhatIsOptional
nodes.summary: The Recipe form says its Steps and Appliances may be left blank, in each Language.

nodes.name: TestBrowserARejectedRecipeOpensOnItsErrorSummary
nodes.summary: In a browser, a rejected Recipe form opens on its error summary, whose first link takes focus to its field, the first refused.

nodes.name: TestBrowserARecipeWithNoIngredientLinksToTheFirstRow
nodes.summary: In a browser, a Recipe with no Ingredient is summed up by a link to the first row.

nodes.name: TestEditingARecipeChangesItsPageAndTheLibrary
nodes.summary: The edit form holds the Recipe as it is, so saving it untouched changes nothing, and what it changes shows on the Recipe's page and in the Library.

nodes.name: TestAnEditIsRefusedAsWritingARecipeIs
nodes.summary: An edit is refused for the same reasons as writing a Recipe, on the edit form, and leaves the Recipe as it was.

nodes.name: TestANewIngredientAddedDuringAnEditIsConfirmedInTheForm
nodes.summary: A new Ingredient added during an edit is confirmed in the form, then created with it.

nodes.name: TestRenamingARecipeToAnotherIsRefusedWithALinkToIt
nodes.summary: Renaming a Recipe to another of the User's is refused with a link to it, while changing only how its own name is written is not.

nodes.name: TestDeletingARecipeRemovesItAndFreesItsIngredients
nodes.summary: Deleting a Recipe asks once, naming it, then removes it and frees its Ingredients for deleting or changing unit. The edit form has no Delete that posts at once.

nodes.name: TestAnIngredientTakenOffARecipeIsFreed
nodes.summary: An Ingredient an edit takes off the Recipe is free again.

nodes.name: TestARecipeIsDeletedFromItsSheet
nodes.summary: The sheet a Recipe's Delete opens asks in the User's Language, and its form posted as htmx lands on the Library confirming it, as a plain post does.

nodes.name: TestAnotherUsersRecipeCanNeitherBeEditedNorDeleted
nodes.summary: Another User's Recipe can be neither edited nor deleted, even by address.

nodes.name: TestTheRecipeLibrarysSearchFindsARecipeThroughATypo
nodes.summary: The Library's search finds a Recipe by name, through a typo, and offers itself only once there is something to search.

nodes.name: TestBrowserSearchesTheLibraryAndDeletesARecipe
nodes.summary: In a browser, the Library's search swaps the list as the User types, keeping focus, and the edit form's Delete opens a sheet asking first: closed, it leaves the Recipe, and confirmed, it lands on the Library saying so.

nodes.name: TestTheRecipeLibraryComesBeforeThePasteForm
nodes.summary: The Recipe Library comes before any form: the page holds no paste form, and its + opens one in a sheet, or without htmx the paste page. Pasted from either, a recipe starts a Run; a paste refused lands on the paste page, with why.

nodes.name: TestBrowserTheFirstRecipeShowsOnAPhoneWithoutScrolling
nodes.summary: On a phone, the first Recipe in the Recipe Library shows without scrolling.

nodes.name: TestBrowserTheAddButtonsReachTheirFormsWithoutJS
nodes.summary: Without JS, the Recipe Library's + reaches the paste form, and the Ingredients page's the add form, each on a page of its own.

nodes.name: runs_test.go
nodes.summary: Seam-1 tests of agent Runs over HTTP: a Run's page and Trace without JavaScript, cancelling, failing Runs a crash left going, the Runs list (newest first, Italian, truncated names) and a browser following a live Trace to its Recipe Draft.

nodes.name: TestARunsPageWithoutJavaScriptShowsItsTraceSoFarAndALink
nodes.summary: Without JavaScript, a Run's page shows its Trace so far and a link to see it further along; once the Run has succeeded, the link to the Recipe Draft it left.

nodes.name: TestCancellingARunEndsItCancelledWithNoRecipeDraft
nodes.summary: Cancelling a Run going ends it as cancelled, and the Recipe Draft its model had already submitted is never shown: a Recipe Draft is only a succeeded Run's. Cancelling it again lands on its page as before.

nodes.name: TestARunACrashLeftGoingIsFailedOnceDandoriStarts
nodes.summary: A Run a crash left going, for every User, is failed once Dandori starts: its page says Dandori stopped while it was going, offers no Cancel, and its stream ends at once.

nodes.name: TestTheRunsPageListsTheUsersRunsNewestFirst
nodes.summary: The Runs page, which the navigation reaches, lists the User's Runs newest first, each named by the first line of what it was given, with its status, kind and when it started, and opening its Trace while it goes and after it ends.

nodes.name: TestTheRunsPageInItalian
nodes.summary: In Italian, the Runs page says in Italian when each Run started, date and time apart.

nodes.name: TestTheRunsPageNamesARunByItsFirstLineCutWhenLong
nodes.summary: The Runs page names a Run by the first line of what it was given that isn't blank, cut with an ellipsis when it is long.

nodes.name: TestBrowserARunsTraceStreamsLiveAndThePageGoesToItsRecipeDraft
nodes.summary: A Browser follows a parse Run's Trace live, as it goes, and once the Run succeeds goes to the Recipe Draft it left.

nodes.name: sheets_test.go
nodes.summary: Browser (Playwright) tests of side-sheet behaviour on the Kitchen page: taps behind or on the veil, Esc closing only the top sheet, Tab focus trapping, scroll locking on phones and keeping a changed form open.

nodes.name: countsRiceInTheBrowser
nodes.summary: countsRiceInTheBrowser adds rice and counts 700 g of it in the pantry from the Kitchen page, closing each sheet, so the page lists its Stock Item.

nodes.name: tapsBehind
nodes.summary: tapsBehind presses the screen where l stands, whatever is over it, as a finger does, and fails the test if the tap clicks anything outside a sheet: a press on the page.

nodes.name: TestBrowserATapBehindASheetClosesItAndPressesNothing
nodes.summary: A tap on the page behind an open sheet closes the sheet and presses nothing there: not the link to the Ingredients, nor the + that opened it.

nodes.name: TestBrowserATapOutsideOrEscClosesTheTopSheetOnly
nodes.summary: With the Movements sheet open over the Count sheet, a tap outside them closes the Movements alone, and so does Esc: each closes the top sheet only.

nodes.name: TestBrowserTabStaysInAnOpenSheet
nodes.summary: With a sheet open, Tab goes round its controls and never reaches the page behind it: past the last, focus may leave the document for the browser's own, then comes back.

nodes.name: TestBrowserScrollingAnOpenSheetLeavesThePageStill
nodes.summary: On a phone, scrolling over an open sheet taller than the screen scrolls the sheet to its end and leaves the page behind it where it was.

nodes.name: TestBrowserATapOnTheVeilKeepsAChangedForm
nodes.summary: A tap on the veil leaves open a sheet whose form the User has changed, with what they typed, until a save; Esc and Close still close it. One unchanged, or only searched, closes on the veil as any sheet does.

nodes.name: shell_test.go
nodes.summary: Seam-1 and browser tests of the app shell: installable manifest, the shared tab navigation and its current marker, Runs placement on phone and desktop rail, and served fonts.

nodes.name: TestAppShellLinksAnInstallableManifest

nodes.name: TestTodayIsServedInTheAppShell
nodes.summary: Checks a signed-up User's / serves Today rendered inside the app shell's nav.

nodes.name: TestEverySignedInPageHasTheSameTabs
nodes.summary: Every signed-in page has the same tabs, Today first, and marks its own; Runs sits apart from them, at the rail's foot.

nodes.name: TestTheShellHasTabsOnceTheLanguageIsChosen
nodes.summary: The shell's tabs lead to pages for a signed-in User who has chosen their Language, so the pages before have none; the Profile marks its own.

nodes.name: TestBrowserPhoneTabsFitAndTheProfileLinksRuns
nodes.summary: On a phone the bottom tabs fit the screen, Runs not among them: the Profile links it.

nodes.name: TestBrowserDesktopRailHasRunsAtItsFoot
nodes.summary: On desktop Runs sits at the rail's foot, apart from the tabs above it.

nodes.name: TestAppShellServesItsFonts
nodes.summary: Checks app.css references exactly three woff2 fonts and each is served.

nodes.name: signin_test.go
nodes.summary: Seam-1 tests of magic-link authentication against the fake Supabase Auth: pages need a signed-in User, invitations, one-time links, long-lived sessions, sign-out revocation and row-level security isolating Users.

nodes.name: TestPagesNeedASignedInUser
nodes.summary: Every page but sign-in needs a signed-in User: the magic link signs them in, and signing out sends them back to sign-in.

nodes.name: TestEachUserSeesOnlyTheirOwnRows
nodes.summary: Users share nothing, and row-level security is what enforces it: the Profile reads the signed-in User's email with no WHERE, and still shows only theirs.

nodes.name: TestAnEmailNotInvitedGetsNoLink
nodes.summary: An email that wasn't invited gets no link, and the page says the same as for one that was: it tells no one who has been invited.

nodes.name: TestSigningInLastsUntilSigningOut
nodes.summary: Signing in lasts until signing out: a day later, past the hour Supabase's access token lasts, the User is still signed in.

nodes.name: TestAMagicLinkSignsInOnce
nodes.summary: A magic link signs in once: opened again, it asks for a new one.

nodes.name: TestTheInvitationSignsIn
nodes.summary: The invitation's own link signs the User in for the first time.

nodes.name: TestAnInvitedUserCanIgnoreTheInvitation
nodes.summary: An invited User who never opened the invitation signs in by asking for a link: Supabase sends its signup confirmation in place of a magic link.

nodes.name: TestSignInRejectsWhatIsNotAnEmail
nodes.summary: An email that isn't one is rejected with what was typed.

nodes.name: TestSigningOutEndsTheSession
nodes.summary: Signing out ends the session at Supabase, not only in this browser: its cookies, kept from before, sign no one in. It does so after the access token has expired, too.

nodes.name: spans_test.go
nodes.summary: Seam-1 tests of OpenTelemetry tracing: request spans with query children, span attributes for User and Language, refusals vs errors, scheduler beats, Supabase client spans without secrets, and Run/model-call GenAI spans, using an in-memory span recorder.

nodes.name: withSpans
nodes.summary: withSpans sends the app's spans to the in-memory exporter it returns.

nodes.name: GetSpans
nodes.summary: GetSpans are the spans ended so far, once no request span is still open.

nodes.name: OnStart
nodes.summary: Counts open server spans so GetSpans can wait for them to end.

nodes.name: OnEnd
nodes.summary: Closes the ended channel when the last open server span ends.

nodes.name: TestARequestIsASpanWithItsQueriesUnderIt
nodes.summary: A request is a span named for its route, with a span for each database query it runs under it.

nodes.name: TestTheHealthCheckAndAssetsAreNotSpans
nodes.summary: The container's health check asks every ten seconds, and every page loads the static assets, the service worker and the manifest: their requests are not spans.

nodes.name: TestARequestSpanSaysWhoAndInWhatLanguage
nodes.summary: A signed-in request's span says who the User was, by their id, the Language the page spoke, what the browser asked for, whether htmx sent it, boosted, and which build served it: never their email. Its response gives its trace id.

nodes.name: TestASignedOutRequestSpanHasNoUser
nodes.summary: A request from no one signed in says so, with no User, in the Language the pages were switched to, and not through htmx; one with no Accept-Language records none.

nodes.name: TestARefusalSaysWhyAndIsNoError
nodes.summary: A request the app refuses says why on its span, naming the fields a form refused, and is no error: the User is told why, and nothing went wrong.

nodes.name: TestARefusedRecipeSaysWhy
nodes.summary: A Recipe refused names the fields of its Ingredient rows it refused; one whose new Ingredient is only asked to be confirmed says so, with no field refused.

nodes.name: TestAServerErrorIsAnErrorAndShowsItsTraceID
nodes.summary: A request that fails on the server is an error, and its page gives the trace id to quote in a report.

nodes.name: TestALogLineInARequestSaysWho
nodes.summary: A line the app logs in a signed-in request says whose it was, by their id.

nodes.name: TestABeatIsASpanWithItsQueriesUnderIt
nodes.summary: A scheduler beat is a span, with the queries that bring each User's kitchen up to now under it.

nodes.name: TestRenewingASessionIsASpanUnderTheRequest
nodes.summary: A signed-in request whose session has expired renews it with Supabase Auth: a client span under the request's.

nodes.name: TestFetchingTheJWKSIsASpanUnderTheFirstCheckedRequest
nodes.summary: A fresh server fetches the JWKS from Supabase Auth to check the first access token it sees: a client span under that request's.

nodes.name: TestSupabaseSpansHoldNoSecret
nodes.summary: No span of a call to Supabase Auth holds a secret: the access or refresh tokens, the API key, or the User's email.

nodes.name: TestSupabaseIsSentNoTraceparent
nodes.summary: Supabase Auth is not told the spans' ids: no call to it sends a traceparent header, even with a propagator set for the whole process.

nodes.name: onlySpan
nodes.summary: onlySpan is the one span that matches, described as what; finding none or several fails the test.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: get requests path from the app with header, as a browser or htmx would, returning the response's header.

nodes.name: parseWithSpans
nodes.summary: parseWithSpans is a signed-in User who knows rice, their spans going to the exporter it returns, who has pasted pastedLasagne for a parse Run the model answers with steps.

nodes.name: runAndCallSpans
nodes.summary: runAndCallSpans is the one Run's span among those exported, and the spans of its calls to the model under it, in order.

nodes.name: TestEachCallToTheModelIsASpanUnderItsRun
nodes.summary: Each call a Run makes to the model is a client span under the Run's span, itself under the request that started it: the model, the tokens and why the model stopped, never what it was asked or said. A call that failed is an error span, and so is retried.

nodes.name: TestAFailedRunIsAnErrorSpanAndACancelledOneIsNot
nodes.summary: A failed Run's span is an error, saying why; a cancelled one's is not, nor is the span of the call it cut off.

nodes.name: TestARunInterruptedByAStopIsAnErrorSpanButNotItsCall
nodes.summary: A Run cut off by Dandori stopping is an error span, interrupted; its call is not.

nodes.name: recordedSpans
nodes.summary: recordedSpans are the spans the app ended. A request's span ends only once its handler returns, which can be after the client has the response, so GetSpans first waits for every request span begun to end.

nodes.name: staple_test.go
nodes.summary: Seam-1 and browser tests of marking an Ingredient a Staple: counting its Stock to nothing, Movements recorded, unmarking, htmx side-sheet answers and Italian wording.

nodes.name: TestMarkingAStapleCountsItsStockToNothing
nodes.summary: Marking an Ingredient a Staple counts each of its Stock Items to nothing, the stock a move took to the freezer included, and says what was counted; they leave the Kitchen page, and each one's Movements tell why, keeping what Dandori believed.

nodes.name: TestMarkingAStapleHeldInOneStorageLocation
nodes.summary: Stock in one Storage Location is confirmed by its quantity alone.

nodes.name: TestMarkingAStapleWithNoStockRecordsNoMovement
nodes.summary: Marking an Ingredient with no stock a Staple records no Movement: it has none to link to, and its unit still changes.

nodes.name: TestUnmarkingAStapleStartsItFromNothing
nodes.summary: A Staple counted to nothing and still a Staple is never counted again, nor moved by a post from an old form. Unmarked, it starts from nothing and is counted like any other.

nodes.name: TestTheIngredientsSheetMarksAStapleInPlace
nodes.summary: Posted from the side sheet by htmx, marking a Staple answers with the sheet's body, confirming what was counted, and tells the page under it that an Ingredient changed: TestBrowserMarksAStapleInTheSideSheet sees the Kitchen page list its stock again.

nodes.name: TestMarkingAStapleInItalian
nodes.summary: The Count to nothing a Staple makes, and the confirmation, speak Italian.

nodes.name: TestBrowserMarksAStapleInTheSideSheet
nodes.summary: In the Ingredients sheet over the Kitchen page, marking an Ingredient a Staple confirms what was counted, and its Stock Item leaves the page under the sheet, still open.

nodes.name: startup_test.go
nodes.summary: Seam-1 tests of app startup: migrations applied before serving, refusing to start on an unreachable database, and the /healthz database report.

nodes.name: TestStartupMigratesTheDatabaseBeforeServing
nodes.summary: A deploy starts the new binary on the database as the last one left it: the migrations a PR added are applied before the app serves.

nodes.name: TestStartupFailsWhenTheDatabaseIsUnreachable
nodes.summary: The app does not start on a database it can't reach: Docker Compose restarts it, and a deploy that never comes up healthy fails.

nodes.name: TestHealthReportsTheDatabase
nodes.summary: Checks GET /healthz answers 200 with the database reported ok.

nodes.name: suggestions_test.go
nodes.summary: Seam-1 and browser tests of Ingredient suggestions on a parsed Recipe Draft: ignoring or accepting a known Ingredient in the same or another unit, Ingredients added or deleted since, and Enter saving the Recipe form.

nodes.name: TestIgnoringASuggestionKeepsTheNewIngredient
nodes.summary: A parsed name close to a known Ingredient's suggests it. Ignoring the suggestion keeps the new Ingredient, which accepting adds beside the known one.

nodes.name: TestAcceptingASuggestionInTheSameUnitUsesTheKnownIngredient
nodes.summary: Accepting a suggestion in the known Ingredient's own unit uses it, quantity kept, and leaves its values as they were. It works in place with htmx and as a plain post.

nodes.name: TestAcceptingASuggestionInAnotherUnitAsksForTheQuantity
nodes.summary: Accepting a suggestion measured in another unit switches the row to it and clears the quantity: Dandori never converts, so the Recipe Draft waits for one in that unit.

nodes.name: TestARecipeDraftUsesAnIngredientAddedSince
nodes.summary: A row whose new Ingredient the User has since added under that name uses the known one, whether the form was opened before or after: in the same unit as it is, in another with its quantity asked for again.

nodes.name: TestARecipeDraftAsksForAnIngredientDeletedSince
nodes.summary: A row whose known Ingredient the User has since deleted asks for its values like a new one, whether the form was opened before or after.

nodes.name: TestBrowserPicksASuggestionInPlace
nodes.summary: In a browser, picking a suggestion swaps its row in place to the known Ingredient, its quantity asked for again in the known unit.

nodes.name: browserHasLasagnaSheets
nodes.summary: browserHasLasagnaSheets adds lasagna sheets, measured in pieces, on the add page.

nodes.name: TestBrowserEnterSavesTheRecipe
nodes.summary: In a browser, Enter in the Recipe form saves it, even with a suggestion and the add buttons above the save button.

nodes.name: targets_test.go
nodes.summary: Seam-1 and browser tests of the Profile's nutrition Targets section: defaults, saving and showing back, per-field refusals, htmx self-swap, per-User isolation and in-place browser saving.

nodes.name: TestANewUserHasNoTargets
nodes.summary: A new User has no Targets, and the Profile says planning needs them, with the calorie tolerance at 5% and carbs and fat named as never aimed at.

nodes.name: TestTargetsAreSavedAndShownBack
nodes.summary: Saved Targets are shown back, confirmed, and planning no longer asks for them.

nodes.name: TestEachRefusedTargetIsRefusedOnItsField
nodes.summary: Each refused value is refused on its own field, saving nothing, with the rest of what was typed kept.

nodes.name: TestTheTargetsSectionAnswersHTMXWithItself
nodes.summary: Posted by htmx, the Targets section answers with itself: saved with a Notice, or refused as typed; a plain post lands on the Profile page.

nodes.name: TestEachUserHasTheirOwnTargets
nodes.summary: Each User sees only their own Targets.

nodes.name: TestBrowserSavesTheTargetsInPlace
nodes.summary: Saving the Targets through a real browser swaps the section in place: a refused field gets the focus, and saved ones are confirmed in a floating Notice.

nodes.name: times_test.go
nodes.summary: Seam-1 tests of the Profile's times-of-day section: defaults per Language, saving with Today following them, ordering refusals and htmx self-swap.

nodes.name: TestANewUserHasTheDefaultTimesOfDay
nodes.summary: A new User's Profile shows the default times of day, as their Language writes them.

nodes.name: TestTimesOfDayAreSavedAndTodayFollowsThem
nodes.summary: Saved times of day, typed in either form, are shown back as the Language writes them, and Today's next Slot follows them.

nodes.name: TestATimeOfDayNotAfterTheOneBeforeIsRefusedOnItsField
nodes.summary: A time of day not after the one before it is refused on its field, saving nothing, with what was typed kept.

nodes.name: TestTheTimesOfDaySectionAnswersHTMXWithItself
nodes.summary: Posted by htmx, the times-of-day section answers with itself: saved with a Notice, or refused as typed.

nodes.name: today_test.go
nodes.summary: Seam-1 tests of the Today page: showing the current or next meal Slot through a day by the Profile's times of day, Language, and what planning still needs for a new User.

nodes.name: TestTodayShowsTheSlotNowOrNext
nodes.summary: Today shows the day's Slot now, or the next one, by the Profile's times of day: the defaults until the User changes them. The day's later Slots are a click away.

nodes.name: TestTodayThroughADay
nodes.summary: Opened through a whole day, Today moves from each Slot to the next: each is now for an hour after its time of day, its last minute included, and the next one is next until then. After midnight, breakfast is next today again.

nodes.name: TestTodayFollowsTheProfilesTimesOfDay
nodes.summary: Today follows the Profile's times of day, not the defaults.

nodes.name: TestTodaySpeaksTheUsersLanguage
nodes.summary: Today speaks the User's Language, Slot kinds included.

nodes.name: TestANewUsersTodaySaysWhatPlanningNeedsAndLinksIt
nodes.summary: Until Dandori plans, a new User's Today says their Plan shows there once it does, and links each thing planning needs, named for what the User does there.

nodes.name: type_test.go
nodes.summary: Browser test that the typographic floor fits a phone in English and Italian: bottom tabs, Profile FieldRows and the Recipe form's ingredient grid never overflow.

nodes.name: TestBrowserTypeFloorFitsAPhone
nodes.summary: The type floor on a phone, in English and Italian: the bottom tabs, a Profile FieldRow and the Recipe form's Ingredient grid still fit the screen.

nodes.name: fits
nodes.summary: fits fails for each element matching selector, or inside one, whose content is wider than it or that runs past the screen's edge.

nodes.name: apptest.go
nodes.summary: Seam-1 test harness: boots Dandori in-process over HTTP on a freshly cloned, migrated Postgres+pgvector database with a manual clock, fake Supabase Auth and a scripted fake LLM, and offers HTTP helpers (Get, PostForm, HTMX variants) and SQL fixtures.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Go functional options (WithConfig) and t.Cleanup-driven teardown; pgtestdb clones a migrated template database per test so tests run in parallel.

nodes.name: WithConfig
nodes.summary: WithConfig lets a test change the app's configuration, on top of any earlier change.

nodes.name: WithUnmigratedDatabase
nodes.summary: WithUnmigratedDatabase starts the app on an empty database, as on its first deploy, so the app's own startup applies every migration.

nodes.name: Start
nodes.summary: Start boots the app against a new database cloned from a migrated template, and runs the test in parallel with the others. Everything is torn down when the test ends; a failed test's database is kept for inspection.

nodes.name: Restart
nodes.summary: Restart stops the app and starts it again on the same database, at the same address, as a deploy or a crash and restart does: its Users stay signed in.

nodes.name: clockSwitch
nodes.summary: clockSwitch sets the clock to the RFC 3339 time posted as now, for tests that can't reach the Harness, such as a browser's.

nodes.name: Exec
nodes.summary: Exec runs sql on the app's database, for fixtures of what the app can't create through its pages yet.

nodes.name: Refuses
nodes.summary: Refuses checks the app's database refuses sql, a write no page makes, with the SQLSTATE code, for a test of what the database itself holds to: a typo in sql fails it.

nodes.name: Scan
nodes.summary: Scan reads the one row sql gives into dest, as the admin role, for a test checking what no page shows yet.

nodes.name: Get
nodes.summary: Get requests path from the app.

nodes.name: HTMXGet
nodes.summary: HTMXGet requests path from the app as HTMX does, marked with HX-Request.

nodes.name: PostForm
nodes.summary: PostForm submits form to path, as a browser does without HTMX, following any redirect.

nodes.name: HTMXPostForm
nodes.summary: HTMXPostForm submits form to path as HTMX does, marked with HX-Request.

nodes.name: postForm
nodes.summary: Builds a form-encoded POST request, optionally marked with HX-Request, and sends it through do.

nodes.name: do
nodes.summary: Sends a request with the harness client and returns a fully read Response, failing the test on transport or read errors.

nodes.name: Harness
nodes.summary: Harness is one running app with its own database.

nodes.name: logBuffer
nodes.summary: logBuffer keeps what the app logs, from whichever goroutine logs it.

nodes.name: Response
nodes.summary: Response is a fully read HTTP response: status, headers, body, method and final path after redirects.

nodes.name: browser.go
nodes.summary: Playwright/Chromium wrapper for browser tests: opens pages on the harness, fails on uncaught script errors, sets the clock via the test switch, holds requests to simulate slow servers, and drives sign-in, clicks, screenshots and Notice checks.

nodes.name: Browser
nodes.summary: Browser opens a browser page on the app. Without Playwright's Chromium (`mise run browsers`) the test is skipped, except in CI, where it fails.

nodes.name: BrowserWithoutJS
nodes.summary: BrowserWithoutJS is a Browser with JavaScript turned off, as the pages are before htmx loads or when it fails: what a page shows with no script.

nodes.name: browser
nodes.summary: Starts Playwright, launches headless Chromium with the given page options, registers cleanup and page-error checks, and returns a Browser bound to the harness.

nodes.name: failOnPageErrors
nodes.summary: failOnPageErrors fails the test, as it ends, for each error page's scripts threw and nothing caught, which the User would only see in the console.

nodes.name: SetClock
nodes.summary: SetClock sets the app's clock to now through the test-only switch.

nodes.name: Hold
nodes.summary: Hold holds every request the browser makes to path, from now until the returned Held is released, and releases them when the test ends.

nodes.name: Fail
nodes.summary: Fail drops the held requests, and any made after, as a lost connection would.

nodes.name: Open
nodes.summary: Open goes to path, as typed into the address bar.

nodes.name: SignIn
nodes.summary: SignIn signs the invited email in as a User does: asks for a magic link, opens it from their mailbox and confirms, landing on Today, or at a first sign-in on the Language choice.

nodes.name: SignUp
nodes.summary: SignUp signs the invited email in for the first time and chooses English, landing on Today.

nodes.name: ChooseLanguage
nodes.summary: ChooseLanguage picks the Language named name on the page and submits it with its form's button named submit.

nodes.name: Click
nodes.summary: Click clicks the button named name, exactly.

nodes.name: IsAt
nodes.summary: IsAt waits for the page to be at path.

nodes.name: Shot
nodes.summary: Shot saves what the window shows as name.png in the folder DANDORI_SHOTS names, doing nothing when it names none. Take it after an assertion, which waits for the swap.

nodes.name: ShotPage
nodes.summary: ShotPage is Shot of the whole page, below the window too.

nodes.name: shot
nodes.summary: Method shot in browser.go.

nodes.name: FollowsRun
nodes.summary: FollowsRun waits for the page to be a Run's, as starting one lands on, then for every Run going to end, and opens the Run's page again to show how it ended: the live page may have gone on to what the Run left.

nodes.name: Sees
nodes.summary: Sees checks the page's main content shows want.

nodes.name: IsConfirmed
nodes.summary: IsConfirmed checks a floating Notice says want, once it has dropped in.

nodes.name: Browser
nodes.summary: Browser is a real, headless Chromium on the app, for the few tests of each page's main path that need the UI as the User gets it: htmx, CSS, scripts. It sets the clock only through POST /_test/clock, as a browser test against a separately started server would.

nodes.name: Held

nodes.summary: Querier runs queries on the pool or within a transaction, so stores can take part in a transaction their caller started.

nodes.name: service_engine.go
nodes.summary: The Runs Engine: starts agent Runs in the background as their User, records status and Trace Events, supports cancel, list, status, live following of Traces and failing Runs left going after a crash, with a span per Run.
nodes.languageNotes: Coordinates goroutines with sync.WaitGroup, a mutex-guarded live map and context cancellation; a separate store context lets a cancelled Run still record how it ended.

nodes.name: New
nodes.summary: New creates an Engine with no Runs going, filling in what cfg leaves unset. Each Run, and each of its calls to the model, is a span made by tp.

nodes.name: Stop
nodes.summary: Stop cancels every Run and waits for them to record how they ended.

nodes.name: FailLeftGoing
nodes.summary: FailLeftGoing fails every Run, of every User, still stored as going, as a crash leaves one: Dandori runs as one process, so at its start no Run is. Each Run's Trace ends as a graceful stop's does.

nodes.name: Start
nodes.summary: Start records a new Run of kind for the signed-in User, asked asked, and carries out b in the background as that User. The tools of b find the Run's id with IDFrom.

nodes.name: execute
nodes.summary: Runs a Run's Brief, then decides its final status (succeeded, cancelled, failed with reason), stores it as the User, emits the Ended event, closes the Run span and removes it from the live set.

nodes.name: Cancel
nodes.summary: Cancel cancels the signed-in User's Run id if it is going, storing it cancelled before it stops, so nothing it does from now on counts, then waits a moment for it to stop, so its Trace says it ended. found is false when they have no such Run; one that has ended stays as it ended.

nodes.name: Status
nodes.summary: Status is the status of the signed-in User's Run id, found false when they have none.

nodes.name: List
nodes.summary: List is the signed-in User's Runs, newest first, without their Traces.

nodes.name: TraceAfter
nodes.summary: TraceAfter is the stored Trace Events of the signed-in User's Run id after the seq-th.

nodes.name: Follow
nodes.summary: Follow follows the Run id's Trace Events from now on, while it goes in this process: the channel closes once the Run has ended, or falls behind, and stop stops following. ok is false when the Run isn't going here.

nodes.name: carryOut
nodes.summary: carryOut carries out b with the agent loop. A panic, say in a tool, fails the Run rather than Dandori.

nodes.name: IDFrom
nodes.summary: IDFrom is the id of the Run a Brief's tool is running in.

nodes.name: Find

nodes.name: Emit

nodes.name: Config

nodes.name: Engine
nodes.summary: Engine runs the Runs going in this process.

nodes.name: trace

nodes.name: 00001_enable_pgvector.sql
nodes.summary: Enables the pgvector PostgreSQL extension that Dandori relies on for vector embeddings; the first goose migration.

nodes.name: 00002_users.sql
nodes.summary: Creates the authenticated role, the current_user_id() function reading the JWT sub claim, and the row-level-secured user table that every owned table references, so Users share nothing (ADR-0015).
nodes.languageNotes: Goose StatementBegin/End wraps a DO block that tolerates an existing role; the own_rows RLS policy keyed on current_user_id() is the pattern every later owned table copies.

nodes.name: 00003_profile.sql
nodes.summary: Creates the per-User profile table, created when the User picks their Language (en/it), with row-level security limiting each User to their own row.

nodes.name: 00004_kitchen.sql
nodes.summary: Creates the kitchen table recording how far each User's kitchen has been brought up to (up_to) and the scheduler's last beat (beaten_at), per ADR-0013.

nodes.name: 00005_slot_times.sql
nodes.summary: Adds breakfast, lunch, snack and dinner times of day to profile, constrained to be all set or all null and in day order.

nodes.name: 00006_ingredient.sql
nodes.summary: Creates the ingredient table of User-entered foods with unit, per-unit nutritional values, storage location and staple flag, unique per normalised name.

nodes.name: 00007_movement.sql
nodes.summary: Creates the append-only movement table, the Kitchen Ledger (ADR-0013), from which Stock Items are derived; Counts keep believed and stated quantities.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED composite foreign key so cascading User deletes finish regardless of table order.

nodes.name: 00008_move.sql
nodes.summary: Adds the 'moved' Movement cause with a moved_to column, so a move between Storage Locations is one Ledger event with check constraints enforcing its shape.

nodes.name: 00009_ingredient_edit.sql
nodes.summary: Grants the authenticated role UPDATE and DELETE on ingredient so Users can edit and delete Ingredients; deferred Movement references still block deleting used ones.

nodes.name: 00010_staple.sql
nodes.summary: Adds the 'staple' Movement cause: marking an Ingredient a Staple counts its Stock Items to zero, with a check constraint on believed/stated/change.

nodes.name: 00011_portion.sql
nodes.summary: Creates the portion table of ready-to-eat servings and the movement_portion join table, and extends movement with the 'added' cause so a Movement can cover a set of Portions.
nodes.languageNotes: Down migration deletes Ingredient-less Movements first so the narrower constraints can be restored.

nodes.name: 00012_recipe.sql
nodes.summary: Creates the recipe table (portions, timings, slot kinds, appliances, steps) and the ordered recipe_ingredient table linking Recipes to the User's Ingredients.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Postgres text[] columns with array containment (<@) checks to restrict slot kinds.

nodes.name: 00013_recipe_edit.sql
nodes.summary: Grants UPDATE/DELETE on recipe and DELETE on recipe_ingredient so Users can edit and delete Recipes, an edit replacing Ingredient rows.

nodes.name: 00014_run.sql
nodes.summary: Creates the run table of agent Runs, their trace_event Trace (kind plus jsonb data), and recipe_draft documents produced by recipe-parsing Runs.

nodes.name: 00015_recipe_draft_delete.sql
nodes.summary: Grants DELETE on recipe_draft so accepting or discarding a Recipe Draft removes it.

nodes.name: 00016_targets.sql
nodes.summary: Adds the daily nutritional Targets (kcal, protein, fibre floors and sugar ceiling, all-or-nothing) and a calorie tolerance defaulting to 5% to profile.

nodes.name: 00017_appliance_kinds.sql
nodes.summary: Constrains a Recipe's appliances to the fixed list of appliance kinds (ADR-0020, domain.ApplianceKinds).

nodes.name: 00018_meal_out.sql
nodes.summary: Adds the Meal Out estimate columns (kcal, protein, carbs, fat, optional fibre and sugar) with defaults to profile.

nodes.name: 00019_exclusions_and_brief.sql
nodes.summary: Adds exclusions and allergies text arrays and the free-text Planning Brief to profile, all starting empty.

nodes.name: 00020_profile_appliances.sql
nodes.summary: Adds a jsonb appliances map to profile keyed by owned appliance kind (with a model note), defaulting to a hob and an oven and restricted to known kinds.
nodes.languageNotes: jsonb key-set subtraction (appliances - ARRAY[...] = '{}') validates the object's keys against an allowlist.
